# SPDX-License-Identifier: EPL-2.0
name: M3 one-build OpenRewrite convergence

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'pom.xml'
      - 'm3/recipe-first/**'
      - 'm3/ci/**'
      - '.github/workflows/m3-one-build-openrewrite-convergence.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  converge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          submodules: false

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
          cache: maven

      - name: 1 - Diff hygiene
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff --check

      - name: 2 - Verify FILE candidate-scope gate fixtures
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m unittest discover -s m3/ci -p 'test_*.py' -v
          if find m3/ci -type d -name __pycache__ -print -quit | grep -q .; then
            echo 'M3 gate test produced untracked Python bytecode'
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: 3 - Prove and install the recipe atoms
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mvn -B -ntp -f m3/recipe-first/pom.xml             -Psemantic-coverage,dag-manifest             clean verify install

      - name: 4 - Verify DAG and scheduler evidence exists
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OUT=m3/recipe-first/target/nebula-m3-dag
          test -s "$OUT/recipe-dag.tsv"
          test -s "$OUT/recipe-dag.sha256"
          test -s "$OUT/camel-route.yaml"
          test -s "$OUT/airflow-dag.py"
          test -s "$OUT/drools-agenda.drl"
          test -s "$OUT/orchestrator-plans.sha256"
          grep -F $'INVENTORY' "$OUT/recipe-dag.tsv"
          grep -F $'ATOMIZATION' "$OUT/recipe-dag.tsv"
          grep -F $'PATTERNIZATION' "$OUT/recipe-dag.tsv"
          grep -F $'DOCUMENTATION' "$OUT/recipe-dag.tsv"
          grep -F 'mutationAuthority' "$OUT/orchestrators.tsv"

      - name: 5 - Root reactor OpenRewrite dry run
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mvn -B -ntp             -Pm3-nebula-file-convergence             rewrite:dryRunNoFork

      - name: 6 - Apply candidate only in disposable checkout
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mvn -B -ntp             -Pm3-nebula-file-convergence             rewrite:runNoFork
          git diff --check
          python3 m3/ci/verify-file-local-candidate.py \
            --repo . \
            --output m3/recipe-first/target/nebula-m3-dag/candidate-paths.txt
          git diff --binary > m3/recipe-first/target/nebula-m3-dag/candidate.patch

      - name: 7 - Second pass must be fixed point
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          find . -path '*/target/rewrite/rewrite.patch' -delete || true
          mvn -B -ntp             -Pm3-nebula-file-convergence             rewrite:dryRunNoFork
          if find . -path '*/target/rewrite/rewrite.patch' -type f -size +0c -print -quit | grep -q .; then
            echo 'M3 fixed-point failure: second OpenRewrite pass still proposes changes.'
            find . -path '*/target/rewrite/rewrite.patch' -type f -size +0c -print
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: 8 - Re-prove recipe tests after candidate application
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mvn -B -ntp -f m3/recipe-first/pom.xml             -Psemantic-coverage             verify

      - name: 9 - Original Nebula Tycho reactor on transformed candidate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          xvfb-run -a mvn -V -B -ntp clean verify -Dtycho.localArtifacts=ignore

      - name: 10 - Verify Tycho left exact FILE postimage untouched
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OUT=m3/recipe-first/target/nebula-m3-dag
          test -f "$OUT/candidate.patch"
          test -s "$OUT/recipe-dag.sha256"
          python3 m3/ci/verify-file-local-candidate.py --repo . \
            --output "$OUT/candidate-paths-after-tycho.txt"
          cmp "$OUT/candidate-paths.txt" "$OUT/candidate-paths-after-tycho.txt"
          git diff --check
          git diff --binary > "$OUT/candidate-after-tycho.patch"
          cmp "$OUT/candidate.patch" "$OUT/candidate-after-tycho.patch"
          test -z "$(git diff --name-only --cached)"

      - name: 11 - Preserve candidate and DAG evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nebula-m3-one-build-convergence
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            m3/recipe-first/target/nebula-m3-dag/**
